answer: Unrepeatable Answer Depletion. Each identity must solve a fresh challenge whose solution derives from a secret held in a shared vault, and the winning answer is consumed on submission so no other agent can replay it. A hidden jade token embedded per challenge marks provenance, letting the atlas ledger reject any answer lacking a token never issued to that solver. An attacker pays one full solve per identity per round because answers cannot be copied, pooled, or reused across the fleet.
